notes: Tuition: the programme's own page does not state a non-EU fee; the institution-wide instellingscollegegeld of EUR 10,648 (2026-2027) applies to students who do not qualify for the statutory fee, including non-EU/EEA students, for full-time bachelor programmes. The amount is for a full year. Application deadline: the programme page only says to enrol after 1 October; no exact day/month/year for non-EU applicants is given, so no intake fact is included. The documents page (diplomawaardering) is general and not specific to this programme, so no document list is extracted.
